{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Remove QA orders
cleaned_data = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = cleaned_data.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue'].sum().reset_index()
channel_revenue = channel_revenue.sort_values(by='revenue', ascending=False)

# Check number of channels
print(f"Unique channels: {cleaned_data['channel'].unique()}")

# Output top channel
channel_revenue"}
